# vep-rs 0.1.1

vep-rs 0.1.1 prints Ensembl VEP's own HGVSc and HGVSp, ported whole from VEP's `hgvs_transcript` and `hgvs_protein`, adds `HGVS_OFFSET` beside them, and moves every dependency to its current release; anyone annotating with `--hgvs` should upgrade.

## Upgrade notes

- `--hgvs` output changes. HGVSp is printed for in-frame insertions between codons, duplications, stop-loss extensions, insertions carrying a stop codon and deletions shifted at the peptide level, where 0.1.0 printed nothing or a different string; HGVSc changes on deletions that cross an exon boundary or the start or stop codon, reverse-strand `delins` ranges, insertions without a readable reference and variants outside the transcript span; and `HGVS_OFFSET` appears as a new key wherever an insertion or deletion was shifted, in every output format. A pipeline that diffs HGVS strings between versions will see those rows move to VEP's values. Flags, input formats and the cache format are unchanged.

## Known issues

- The Ensembl default input format reader skips a record whose strand is written `+` or `-`; write `1` or `-1` until the reader accepts both ([#issue](https://github.com/natera-open-source/vep-rs/issues)).
